recipeCanonicalization: UTF-8 JSON, keys sorted lexicographically, separators ',' and ':', no whitespace, no trailing newline; SHA-256 over those exact bytes
modelSha256Definition: SHA-256 of encoder-int8.onnx (the frozen graph). This matches verify_official_run_v26.py ENCODER_SHA256. Do not substitute a combined encoder+probe digest; the probe head is identified by prefix metadata/runtime, not this field.
prefixSha256Field: prefixSha256 is the authoritative key (verify_official_run_v26.py prefix_info). The design's shorthand 'prefixSha' is the same value; include it only as an optional alias.

recording.note: PCM SHA and duration are local decode references; the cloud run must measure and record its own values. Never substitute a reference value for a measurement.

prefix.note: 125,976 B = 8 chunks of 5x768 float32 frames plus bandroom-acoustic-chunk-v1 framing. The cloud run must record the measured prefix SHA; the local reference is a comparison only.

g5AcousticPlan.basis: bandroom_acoustic.acoustic_stage.windows(sample_count): frameSamples=320, receptiveSamples=400, windowFrames=800, contextFrames=100, offsets=[0,400], features=768
g5AcousticPlan.cutRule: B persists verifier-plan chunks 0..5; C restores them and computes 6..9; 0 < cut < chunks
g5AcousticPlan.configSource: release analysis-config.json.acousticConfig, used verbatim; never invent configSha256
g5AcousticPlan.persistence: /mnt/data/bandroom-g5/acoustic-plan (B writes, C must read; missing prefix is a blocker, not a recompute)
g5AcousticPlan.parallelToV26Prefix: the 6-part 120/80 ms v26 prefix remains for G3 resume; plan chunks are the G5 acoustic-recovery evidence

feedback.prefix: 声学链路验收（不代表纠音盲测达标）。

fences.noteD: Run D is a read-only cold reference with no acoustic lease; its officialRunId is the G5 coldRunId and must differ from A/B/C
fences.reset: HJK legacy qa_acoustic_leases row (recipe 602a745b..., fence 2) deleted by owner-authorised QA-only reset per B4
fences.policy: Record measured values; assert strictly increasing. Do not hardcode 1/2/3 as pass evidence if the measured reset baseline differs; stop and report instead.
